data: What is the approximate perplexity of the line with empty squares at 500 iterations in the right graph?

The question asks for the approximate perplexity of the line with empty squares at 500 iterations in the right graph. From the caption, we know that the points in the graphs represent the perplexities in every 100th iteration. Therefore, we need to look at the line corresponding to 500 iterations on the x-axis and find the value of the y-axis where this line intersects with the empty square markers.

Looking at the right graph, the line with empty squares corresponds to 500 roles. At approximately 500 iterations, the line with empty squares intersects with the y-axis at around 200. Therefore, the approximate perplexity of the line with empty squares at 500 iterations in the right graph is 200.
